Had a great experience at Cafe Iftar! We tried the Tandoori Platter, which had a good variety of chicken, fish, mutton seekh and chicken tikka. The neer dosa was amazing! My kids also loved their favourite childhood noodles and the malai kebab.

Definitely a great place to stop by if you're going for a long drive towards Devanahalli. Special mention to Captain Ramakrishna for his excellent service and hospitality. Highly recommended!

Had a really good experience at Cafe Ifthar, Devanahalli. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of flavour, with a nice variety of options to choose from. The ambience was comfortable and welcoming, making it a great place to enjoy a meal with family and friends.
The service was friendly and attentive, and the overall hospitality was excellent. Everything was served nicely and the quality of the food was impressive.
A special mention for the tasty food, generous portions, and warm hospitality. Definitely a place worth visiting when you’re in Devanahalli. Highly recommended! 👍🍽️

Honestly, I feel 4.5 stars for this restaurant is like unbelievable..

We travelled 40km to eat in this restaurant only to see that it offers food at exorbitant prices...
It looks affordable on menu card but when its lands on your table you are like what kind business model is this...

What they call platter is utterly rubbish and is meant for only 4 people (costs Rs. 2400)...imagine it contains hara bhara kebab and pineapple only to increase the size of the platter (who wants to have it in a non veg platter)..

Ask me about the fish... Hamoor which costs Rs. 400/kg in market, they asked me to pay Rs.1400 for the same...seer fish Rs. 700 per piece...I felt I almost landed in a 4 star hotel (though the ambience of this place was like ordinary)...

Service:
They are not aware what's in the platter and clueless about what dishes they serve...
They dont know the order in which the orderrd menu comes on the table and completely clueless about prices of sea food which is decided by the manager on floor.... yes if he likes you, he might quote you slightly less (may be)...

Lastly, they have branded themselves as a premium restaurant but their cash machine doesnt accept sodexo...

A thoroughly frustrating experience and we came out frustrated yet smiling faces only to be relived that we dont have to visit this place again...

Thank you for letting us leave that place...
